name: Main-GW
frr:
frr defaults traditional
hostname Main-GW
service integrated-vtysh-config
log file /tmp/frr.log
interface eth0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
 ip ospf cost 10
interface eth1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
 ip ospf cost 10
interface eth2
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
 ip ospf cost 1
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.10.255.2
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface eth0
 no passive-interface eth1
 no passive-interface eth2
 network 10.10.255.2/32 area 0
 network 10.255.0.1/30 area 0
 network 10.255.0.5/30 area 0
 network 10.255.0.10/30 area 0
 default-information originate metric 10
ip route 192.0.2.100/32 10.255.0.9 1
ip route 192.0.2.100/32 Null0 254
ip route 10.10.0.0/16 Null0 254
ip route 10.20.0.0/16 Null0 254
ip route 10.30.0.0/16 Null0 254
